senses.en: to play music to support a singer or another player
senses.pattern: accompany a singer on the piano / be accompanied by a guitar / accompany the choir
senses.example: Her younger brother will [[accompany]] her on the guitar when she sings at the talent show.
senses.example_zh: 她在才藝表演上唱歌時，弟弟會用吉他為她伴奏。

senses.en: to happen or appear together with something else
senses.pattern: be accompanied by fever / be accompanied by thunder / strong winds accompanied by rain
senses.example: The typhoon's strong winds were [[accompanied]] by heavy rain that flooded several streets downtown.
senses.example_zh: 颱風的強風伴隨著豪雨，淹沒了市中心好幾條街道。
senses.note: 常用被動 be accompanied by

gsat.sentence: Most of the performance was not [[accompanied]] by any instrument.
Moreover, the effect is often [[accompanied]] by space motion sickness, headaches, and nausea.

senses.en: to plan to have enough time or money for something
senses.pattern: allow two hours for the trip / allow extra time / allow plenty of room
senses.example: You should [[allow]] at least forty minutes to get through airport security during the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 連假期間，你應該預留至少四十分鐘通過機場安檢。

senses.en: to include something when planning or judging
senses.pattern: allow for delays / allow for inflation / allowing for traffic
senses.example: Even [[allowing]] for the bad weather, the team's performance in the final was disappointing.
senses.example_zh: 即使考慮到天氣不佳，這支隊伍在決賽的表現仍令人失望。

senses.en: to make something possible
senses.pattern: allow for flexibility / allow for more choices / allow for future growth
senses.example: The classroom's movable desks [[allow]] for many different kinds of group activities.
senses.example_zh: 教室裡可移動的課桌使多種不同的小組活動成為可能。
senses.note: 主詞多為事物、設計或制度

gsat.sentence: Installed in Detroit in 1920, Potts’ three-color system [[allowed]] for the added signal “proceed with caution” to be displayed.
They were then replaced by colorful glass beads, [[allowing]] for more detailed beadwork and color patterns.

senses.en: to take on a duty, power, or position
senses.pattern: assume responsibility / assume office / assume control / assume the role of
senses.example: When the captain was injured, Mia [[assumed]] responsibility for leading the team through the final match.
senses.example_zh: 隊長受傷後，米亞承擔起帶領球隊打完最後一場比賽的責任。

senses.en: to begin to have a quality, or to pretend to
senses.pattern: assume an air of confidence / assume a new importance / assume the form of
senses.example: Although he was terrified, Leo [[assumed]] an air of calm and walked onto the stage.
senses.example_zh: 雖然心裡害怕，里歐還是裝出鎮定的樣子走上舞台。

senses.en: the feature that makes something especially good
senses.pattern: the beauty of the plan / the beauty of it is that / that's the beauty of it
senses.example: The [[beauty]] of this app is that it works perfectly even without an internet connection.
senses.example_zh: 這個應用程式的妙處在於沒有網路也能正常運作。
senses.note: 常用 the beauty of A is that …

senses.en: to arrange in advance to have a seat, room, or ticket
senses.pattern: book a flight / book a table / book in advance / be fully booked
senses.example: We [[booked]] a table for six at the seafood restaurant to celebrate Grandma's birthday.
senses.example_zh: 我們在海鮮餐廳預訂了六人的桌位，替奶奶慶生。

senses.en: written records of the money a business receives and spends
senses.pattern: keep the books / balance the books / check the company's books
senses.example: My aunt keeps the [[books]] for her flower shop and checks every payment at night.
senses.example_zh: 我阿姨負責管理她那間花店的帳簿，每晚核對每一筆款項。

gsat.sentence: Having saved enough money, Joy [[booked]] two trips for this summer vacation, one to France and the other to Australia.

senses.en: money or property used to start or run a business
senses.pattern: raise capital / start-up capital / invest capital / a lack of capital
senses.example: The young couple needed more [[capital]] to open a second bakery near the train station.
senses.example_zh: 這對年輕夫妻需要更多資金，才能在火車站附近開第二家麵包店。

senses.en: a letter in its large form, such as A
senses.pattern: in capitals / in block capitals / a capital letter / begin with a capital
senses.example: Please write your full name in [[capitals]] at the top of the application form.
senses.example_zh: 請在申請表上方用大寫字母寫下你的全名。

gsat.sentence: This comparative advantage is determined by key factors of production such as land, [[capital]], and labor.

senses.en: unfair or unkind and deserving no respect
senses.pattern: a cheap trick / a cheap shot / a cheap joke / cheap remarks
senses.example: Making fun of a classmate's accent to get a laugh is a [[cheap]] trick.
senses.example_zh: 取笑同學的口音來博取笑聲，是很卑劣的手段。

senses.en: unwilling to spend money
senses.pattern: too cheap to tip / a cheap boss / don't be so cheap
senses.example: Uncle Ray is so [[cheap]] that he reuses tea bags three or four times.
senses.example_zh: 雷叔叔非常小氣，一個茶包都要重複泡三、四次。
senses.note: 美式口語；英式多用 mean

senses.en: to influence someone's opinion or judgment, often unfairly
senses.pattern: color one's judgment / color one's view / be colored by experience
senses.example: Don't let one bad experience [[color]] your opinion of the whole country and its people.
senses.example_zh: 別讓一次不好的經驗影響你對整個國家及其人民的看法。

senses.en: interesting and lively details or qualities
senses.pattern: local color / add color to / full of color
senses.example: The street musicians and night markets add local [[color]] to the old harbor town.
senses.example_zh: 街頭藝人和夜市為這座古老的港口小鎮增添了地方特色。

senses.en: people you know who can help you
senses.pattern: have connections / use one's connections / business connections / family connections
senses.example: He got the internship through his father's [[connections]] in the film industry, not through talent.
senses.example_zh: 他是靠父親在電影圈的人脈才得到實習機會，而不是靠才華。

senses.en: a train, bus, or plane that you change to
senses.pattern: miss one's connection / catch a connection / a connection to Paris
senses.example: Our first flight landed an hour late, so we missed our [[connection]] to Vancouver.
senses.example_zh: 我們的第一班飛機晚了一小時降落，因此錯過了飛往溫哥華的轉乘班次。

senses.en: to report on an event for the news media
senses.pattern: cover a story / cover the election / cover the Olympics
senses.example: The newspaper sent two young reporters to [[cover]] the flood in the southern villages.
senses.example_zh: 報社派了兩名年輕記者去報導南部村莊的水災。

senses.en: to be enough money to pay for something
senses.pattern: cover the cost / cover expenses / cover the rent
senses.example: Her part-time salary barely [[covers]] the rent, so she cooks at home to save money.
senses.example_zh: 她打工的薪水只勉強足以支付房租，所以她在家煮飯省錢。

senses.en: to travel a particular distance
senses.pattern: cover a distance / cover ten kilometers / cover a lot of ground
senses.example: The hikers [[covered]] twenty kilometers on the first day before setting up camp by the river.
senses.example_zh: 登山客第一天走完二十公里後，才在河邊紮營。

gsat.sentence: Homer was assigned to [[cover]] the inauguration of President Lincoln and, later, the Civil War.
Children in this region often start running at an early age, [[covering]] great distances to fetch water and firewood or to reach the nearest school.

senses.en: the act of giving birth to a baby
senses.pattern: a difficult delivery / the delivery room / a natural delivery
senses.example: After a long and difficult [[delivery]], both the mother and her baby girl were healthy.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長而艱難的分娩，母親和女嬰都平安健康。

senses.en: the way someone speaks or performs in public
senses.pattern: a confident delivery / improve one's delivery / a clear delivery
senses.example: The speech itself was short, but her calm, confident [[delivery]] impressed all the judges.
senses.example_zh: 演講本身很短，但她沉穩自信的演說方式讓所有評審印象深刻。
senses.note: 動詞：deliver a speech 發表演說

senses.en: the soft, fine feathers of a bird
senses.pattern: a down jacket / a down pillow / goose down / filled with down
senses.example: This sleeping bag is filled with goose [[down]], so it is light but very warm.
senses.example_zh: 這個睡袋裡填充的是鵝的羽絨，所以又輕又保暖。

senses.en: (of a computer system) not working
senses.pattern: the system is down / the server went down / the website is down
senses.example: The school's website was [[down]] all morning, so nobody could check the exam results.
senses.example_zh: 學校網站整個早上都當機，所以沒有人能查詢考試成績。

senses.en: sad or unhappy
senses.pattern: feel down / be a bit down / seem down
senses.example: Whenever Tina feels [[down]], she calls her grandmother, who always knows how to cheer her up.
senses.example_zh: 每當蒂娜情緒低落時，她就打電話給奶奶，奶奶總是知道怎麼逗她開心。

gsat.sentence: According to psychologist Dean Burnett, people feel [[down]] in January owing to post-holiday discontent, and the Blue Monday claim makes it seem like there are scientific reasons for this.

senses.en: to remove everything that is inside something
senses.pattern: empty the trash / empty one's pockets / empty a bottle
senses.example: The guard asked every visitor to [[empty]] their pockets before walking through the gate.
senses.example_zh: 警衛要求每位訪客在通過大門前先清空口袋。

senses.en: (of a river) to flow into a sea or lake
senses.pattern: empty into the sea / empty into the lake / empty into the Pacific
senses.example: The river flows through three countries before it finally [[empties]] into the sea.
senses.example_zh: 這條河流經三個國家，最後注入大海。

senses.en: having no real meaning, value, or sincerity
senses.pattern: empty promises / empty words / an empty threat
senses.example: The coach's warning turned out to be an [[empty]] threat; nobody was ever punished for being late.
senses.example_zh: 教練的警告結果只是空洞的威脅，從來沒有人因遲到而受罰。

senses.en: to look at someone or something carefully or with interest
senses.pattern: eye someone suspiciously / eye the cake hungrily / eye each other warily
senses.example: The cat sat by the window and [[eyed]] the birds in the garden hungrily.
senses.example_zh: 那隻貓坐在窗邊，虎視眈眈地注視著花園裡的鳥兒。

senses.en: a natural ability to notice or judge things well
senses.pattern: have an eye for detail / a good eye for color / a keen eye
senses.example: With her sharp [[eye]] for detail, Nora quickly spotted three mistakes in the report.
senses.example_zh: 諾拉對細節的眼光敏銳，很快就找出報告裡的三個錯誤。
senses.note: 此義用單數：have an eye for

senses.en: to officially submit a complaint, request, or legal case
senses.pattern: file a lawsuit / file a complaint / file a patent / file a report
senses.example: Several customers [[filed]] a complaint after the airline lost their luggage for a week.
senses.example_zh: 航空公司把行李弄丟一週後，數名顧客提出了申訴。

senses.en: to walk in a line, one behind another
senses.pattern: file into the hall / file out of the room / file past
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the students [[filed]] quietly out of the classroom.
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，學生們排成縱隊安靜地走出教室。
senses.note: in single file＝排成一路縱隊

gsat.sentence: Patents with innovations on Knight’s ideas were [[filed]] nationwide.
One can [[file]] a lawsuit in court.

senses.en: to start an organization, school, or city
senses.pattern: found a company / found a school / be founded in 1920
senses.example: The two sisters [[founded]] a small publishing company that prints books by local writers.
senses.example_zh: 這對姐妹創立了一家小型出版社，專門印行本地作家的書。

senses.en: to base something on a belief, idea, or fact
senses.pattern: be founded on trust / be founded on facts / a well-founded fear
senses.example: A lasting friendship is [[founded]] on trust and respect rather than on shared hobbies.
senses.example_zh: 長久的友誼是以信任和尊重為基礎，而非共同的嗜好。
senses.note: 常用被動 be founded on

gsat.sentence: Benjamin Franklin, one of the [[Founding]] Fathers of the United States, was not only a great politician but also a highly accomplished scientist and inventor.

senses.en: to understand something fully, especially something difficult
senses.pattern: grasp the meaning / grasp a concept / grasp the importance of / fail to grasp
senses.example: It took me a few minutes to [[grasp]] what the physics teacher was trying to explain.
senses.example_zh: 我花了幾分鐘才理解物理老師想解釋的內容。

senses.en: a person's understanding of a subject
senses.pattern: a good grasp of / a firm grasp of grammar / beyond one's grasp
senses.example: After living in Madrid for two years, she has a solid [[grasp]] of Spanish grammar.
senses.example_zh: 在馬德里住了兩年後，她對西班牙文法已有扎實的掌握。

senses.en: a large number of people or things
senses.pattern: a host of problems / a whole host of reasons / a host of options
senses.example: The new library offers a [[host]] of free activities for children during summer vacation.
senses.example_zh: 新圖書館在暑假期間為孩童提供許多免費活動。
senses.note: 用於 a host of＋複數名詞

senses.en: an animal or plant that a parasite lives on
senses.pattern: a host animal / a host cell / the parasite's host
senses.example: The parasite cannot survive for long once it leaves the body of its [[host]].
senses.example_zh: 這種寄生蟲一旦離開宿主的身體就無法存活太久。

senses.en: to provide the place and services for an event
senses.pattern: host the Olympics / host a conference / host a party
senses.example: Our school will [[host]] the national science fair for the first time next spring.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校明年春天將首度主辦全國科展。

gsat.sentence: The temple celebrated Mazu Festival by [[hosting]] ten days of lion dances, Taiwanese operas, and traditional hand puppet shows.
Bekoji will [[host]] an international long-distance competition.

senses.en: to become stuck and unable to move or work
senses.pattern: the printer jammed / the door jammed / the paper keeps jamming
senses.example: The printer [[jammed]] again just as I was printing the last page of my report.
senses.example_zh: 我正要印報告的最後一頁時，印表機又卡住了。

senses.en: to fill a place tightly with people or things
senses.pattern: jam the streets / be jammed with fans / jam clothes into a bag
senses.example: Thousands of excited fans [[jammed]] the square to welcome the baseball team home.
senses.example_zh: 數千名興奮的球迷擠滿了廣場，歡迎棒球隊歸來。
senses.note: in a jam＝陷入困境（口語）

senses.en: a serious magazine about a particular subject or profession
senses.pattern: a medical journal / a scientific journal / an academic journal / publish in a journal
senses.example: Her study on sleep and memory was published in a leading medical [[journal]] last month.
senses.example_zh: 她關於睡眠與記憶的研究上個月刊登在一份頂尖的醫學期刊上。

senses.en: to invent a false story, excuse, or piece of evidence
senses.pattern: manufacture an excuse / manufacture evidence / manufacture a story
senses.example: He [[manufactured]] an excuse about a sick relative to avoid taking the math test.
senses.example_zh: 他捏造了親戚生病的藉口，以逃避數學考試。

senses.en: to avoid something unpleasant
senses.pattern: miss the traffic / miss the crowds / miss the rush hour
senses.example: We set off at five in the morning to [[miss]] the holiday traffic on the highway.
senses.example_zh: 我們清晨五點就出發，以躲過高速公路上的連假車潮。

senses.en: to fail to hit something
senses.pattern: miss the target / miss the goal / narrowly miss a tree
senses.example: The striker's powerful shot [[missed]] the goal by only a few centimeters.
senses.example_zh: 那名前鋒的強力射門只差幾公分，沒有射中球門。

senses.en: to notice that something is lost or absent
senses.pattern: miss one's wallet / not miss it until later / be missed at once
senses.example: I didn't [[miss]] my keys until I reached the front door and searched my bag.
senses.example_zh: 我直到走到大門口翻找包包，才發覺鑰匙不見了。

gsat.sentence: Because of its small size, it might have [[missed]] the other car completely.

senses.en: to meet people who may be useful to your career
senses.pattern: network with professionals / a chance to network / a networking event
senses.example: The job fair gives graduates a chance to [[network]] with managers from different industries.
senses.example_zh: 就業博覽會讓畢業生有機會與各產業的主管建立人脈。

senses.en: a state in which laws and rules are obeyed
senses.pattern: law and order / keep order / restore order / maintain public order
senses.example: Extra police officers were sent to keep [[order]] outside the stadium after the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽結束後，警方加派人手到體育場外維持秩序。

senses.en: a request for goods to be made or supplied
senses.pattern: place an order / cancel an order / receive an order for
senses.example: The factory received a large [[order]] for bicycle parts from a company in Germany.
senses.example_zh: 這家工廠接到一家德國公司的大筆自行車零件訂單。

senses.en: a document that allows you to enter or travel
senses.pattern: a boarding pass / a bus pass / a monthly pass / a visitor's pass
senses.example: Every visitor must show a [[pass]] at the gate before entering the research center.
senses.example_zh: 每位訪客進入研究中心前，都必須在大門口出示通行證。

senses.en: a narrow route through or over mountains
senses.pattern: a mountain pass / cross a pass / a narrow pass
senses.example: Heavy snow closed the mountain [[pass]], so the truck drivers had to wait in the village.
senses.example_zh: 大雪封閉了山口，卡車司機只好在村子裡等候。

senses.en: to officially approve a law by voting
senses.pattern: pass a law / pass a bill / pass a resolution
senses.example: The city council [[passed]] a law banning smoking in all public parks and playgrounds.
senses.example_zh: 市議會通過了一項法案，禁止在所有公園和遊樂場吸菸。

senses.en: one of the large pieces forming the earth's surface
senses.pattern: tectonic plates / the Pacific Plate / plate movement / where two plates meet
senses.example: Earthquakes often happen where two [[plates]] push against each other deep under the ground.
senses.example_zh: 地震常發生在兩個板塊於地底深處互相推擠的地方。

senses.en: a flat piece of metal with numbers or a name
senses.pattern: a license plate / a number plate / a brass plate / a name plate
senses.example: A witness wrote down the license [[plate]] of the car that drove away after the accident.
senses.example_zh: 一名目擊者記下了事故後駛離的那輛車的車牌。

gsat.sentence: The Indian [[plate]]’s northward movement is not new.
Such dangers are now obvious in India, where the movement of the [[plate]] continues.

senses.en: the head of a company, club, or organization
senses.pattern: company president / vice president / club president / president of the student council
senses.example: The [[president]] of the software company announced plans to open three new offices in Asia.
senses.example_zh: 這家軟體公司的總裁宣布了在亞洲開設三間新辦公室的計畫。

senses.en: the head of a college or university
senses.pattern: university president / college president / president of the university
senses.example: The university [[president]] handed each graduate a diploma and shook hands with their parents.
senses.example_zh: 大學校長把畢業證書頒給每位畢業生，並與他們的家長握手。

gsat.sentence: He is the executive vice [[president]] of the HSUS.

senses.en: to give someone the things they need to live
senses.pattern: provide for one's family / provide for the children / be well provided for
senses.example: He works two jobs to [[provide]] for his three children and his elderly parents.
senses.example_zh: 他兼兩份工作來供養三個孩子和年邁的父母。

senses.en: only if; on condition that
senses.pattern: provided (that) / provided you finish first / providing (that)
senses.example: The picnic will go ahead as planned, [[provided]] the rain stops before ten o'clock.
senses.example_zh: 只要雨在十點前停，野餐就會照原定計畫舉行。

senses.en: to get back something lost, stolen, or owed
senses.pattern: recover stolen goods / recover lost data / recover the cost
senses.example: Police [[recovered]] the stolen paintings from an empty warehouse near the harbor.
senses.example_zh: 警方在港口附近的一間空倉庫找回了失竊的畫作。

senses.en: to get back an ability, a sense, or control
senses.pattern: recover consciousness / recover one's sight / recover one's balance
senses.example: The skater slipped on the ice but quickly [[recovered]] her balance and finished the routine.
senses.example_zh: 那名滑冰選手在冰上滑了一下，但很快恢復平衡，完成了整套動作。

gsat.sentence: Zebrafish can quickly [[recover]] vision after damage to the retina.
To find an expert, who would [[recover]] the lost information for you, is probably the easiest solution.

senses.en: (of food) containing a lot of butter, cream, or fat
senses.pattern: rich food / a rich chocolate cake / a rich sauce / too rich for me
senses.example: The cream sauce was so [[rich]] that I could only finish half of the pasta.
senses.example_zh: 奶油醬太過濃郁油膩，我只吃得下半盤義大利麵。

senses.en: (of soil) containing what plants need to grow well
senses.pattern: rich soil / rich farmland / rich earth
senses.example: Farmers settled along the river because its [[rich]] soil produced two crops every year.
senses.example_zh: 農民沿河定居，因為那裡肥沃的土壤一年可以收成兩次。

senses.en: a large group of fish swimming together
senses.pattern: a school of fish / a school of dolphins / swim in schools
senses.example: While diving near the island, we saw a huge [[school]] of silver fish swim past.
senses.example_zh: 我們在島嶼附近潛水時，看見一大群銀色的魚游過。

senses.en: a group of thinkers or artists with similar ideas
senses.pattern: a school of thought / the Impressionist school / two schools of thought
senses.example: There are two [[schools]] of thought about whether homework really helps young children learn.
senses.example_zh: 關於作業是否真的有助於幼童學習，有兩派不同的看法。

senses.en: to shock someone or make a belief less strong
senses.pattern: be shaken by the news / shake one's confidence / shake one's faith
senses.example: The team's confidence was badly [[shaken]] after they lost three games in a row.
senses.example_zh: 連輸三場比賽後，這支球隊的信心嚴重動搖。
senses.note: 三態 shake–shook–shaken；shake up＝徹底改變

senses.en: a cold drink of milk, ice cream, and flavoring
senses.pattern: a chocolate shake / a strawberry shake / a protein shake / order a shake
senses.example: After practice, the boys each ordered a burger and a large chocolate [[shake]].
senses.example_zh: 練習結束後，男孩們各點了一個漢堡和一大杯巧克力奶昔。

senses.en: to avoid talking about or dealing with something difficult
senses.pattern: skirt the issue / skirt the question / skirt around the problem
senses.example: The manager kept [[skirting]] the question of when the workers would finally be paid.
senses.example_zh: 經理一直迴避工人究竟何時能領到薪水的問題。

senses.en: to go around the edge of something
senses.pattern: skirt the lake / skirt the forest / skirt the edge of town
senses.example: The hiking trail [[skirts]] the lake before climbing steeply into the pine forest.
senses.example_zh: 這條登山步道沿著湖的邊緣繞行，接著陡升進入松林。

senses.en: a device that sound comes out of
senses.pattern: a wireless speaker / a pair of speakers / a smart speaker / speaker volume
senses.example: The music from the [[speakers]] was so loud that we could not hear each other talk.
senses.example_zh: 喇叭傳出的音樂太大聲，我們都聽不見彼此說話。

senses.en: the person who leads debates in a parliament
senses.pattern: the Speaker of the House / be elected Speaker / the Speaker of Parliament
senses.example: The [[Speaker]] of the parliament asked the members to stop shouting and return to their seats.
senses.example_zh: 國會議長要求議員們停止叫喊並回到座位上。

gsat.sentence: Researchers in Japan have installed on a train a [[speaker]] that barks like a dog and snorts like a deer in order to prevent collisions with animals on the tracks.

senses.en: difficult or unpleasant to deal with
senses.pattern: a sticky situation / a sticky problem / a sticky moment
senses.example: Lending money to close friends can put you in a [[sticky]] situation if they cannot pay.
senses.example_zh: 借錢給好友，萬一對方還不出來，可能會讓你陷入棘手的處境。

senses.en: (of weather or people) hot, damp, and uncomfortable
senses.pattern: hot and sticky / a sticky afternoon / sticky weather / feel sticky
senses.example: It was a hot, [[sticky]] afternoon, and everyone on the crowded bus longed for a cold shower.
senses.example_zh: 那是個炎熱濕黏的午後，擁擠公車上的每個人都渴望沖個冷水澡。

gsat.sentence: The roasting heat and high humidity made me feel hot and [[sticky]], no matter what I did to cool off.

senses.en: to take a job or position after someone else
senses.pattern: succeed someone as chairman / be succeeded by / succeed one's father
senses.example: Nobody knows who will [[succeed]] the conductor when she leaves the orchestra at the end of the season.
senses.example_zh: 沒有人知道指揮在樂季結束離開樂團後，將由誰接替她。

senses.en: to gain a title or position after someone dies
senses.pattern: succeed to the throne / succeed to the title / succeed to the crown
senses.example: The young prince [[succeeded]] to the throne at the age of nine after his father's death.
senses.example_zh: 父親去世後，年幼的王子在九歲時繼承王位。

senses.en: a liking or preference for something
senses.pattern: a taste for adventure / develop a taste for / suit all tastes / musical tastes
senses.example: Over the years, Dad has developed a [[taste]] for jazz and now collects old records.
senses.example_zh: 這些年來，爸爸漸漸養成對爵士樂的愛好，現在還收藏老唱片。

senses.en: the ability to judge what is beautiful or suitable
senses.pattern: have good taste / in bad taste / taste in clothes / a person of taste
senses.example: Everyone praises her [[taste]] in clothes, yet she rarely buys anything expensive.
senses.example_zh: 大家都稱讚她的穿衣品味，但她很少買昂貴的東西。

senses.en: a short first experience of something
senses.pattern: a taste of freedom / a first taste of success / get a taste of
senses.example: The summer camp gave the students their first [[taste]] of life away from home.
senses.example_zh: 這次夏令營讓學生們初次體驗離家生活的滋味。
senses.note: 常用 a taste of＋名詞

gsat.sentence: The fortune cookie was based on a Japanese snack, but Hagiwara sweetened the recipe to appeal to American [[tastes]].
The fragrances at this scent shop are largely customized to meet the individual shopper’s [[taste]].

senses.en: to make someone feel sympathy, sadness, or gratitude
senses.pattern: be deeply touched by / touch one's heart / be touched that
senses.example: We were deeply [[touched]] by the letters that the children wrote to the firefighters.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們寫給消防員的信讓我們深受感動。

senses.en: a small amount of something
senses.pattern: a touch of salt / a touch of humor / a touch of sadness
senses.example: Add a [[touch]] of lemon juice to the soup just before you serve it.
senses.example_zh: 上桌前在湯裡加少許檸檬汁。

senses.en: a small detail added to improve or complete something
senses.pattern: the finishing touches / a personal touch / a nice touch
senses.example: The artist spent the whole evening putting the finishing [[touches]] on her painting.
senses.example_zh: 那位畫家花了整個晚上為她的畫作做最後的潤飾。

senses.en: the same in all parts or at all times
senses.pattern: uniform in size / a uniform standard / uniform in color / a uniform temperature
senses.example: The bricks must be [[uniform]] in size, or the wall will not stand straight.
senses.example_zh: 磚塊的大小必須一致，否則牆面會砌不直。

senses.en: importance, influence, or value
senses.pattern: carry weight / give weight to / add weight to an argument / attach weight to
senses.example: The judges gave equal [[weight]] to creativity and teamwork when choosing the winning project.
senses.example_zh: 評審在選出優勝作品時，把創意和團隊合作看得同等重要。

senses.en: a great worry or responsibility
senses.pattern: a weight off one's mind / the weight of responsibility / a weight on one's shoulders
senses.example: Finally telling her parents the truth was a huge [[weight]] off her mind.
senses.example_zh: 終於向父母說出實情，讓她卸下了心頭的重擔。

quiz.stem: At the graduation ceremony, the music teacher ______ the school choir on the piano as they sang a farewell song to the seniors.
quiz.explain_zh: accompany＝為…伴奏。音樂老師彈鋼琴替合唱團伴奏。

quiz.stem: The content of Kevin's speech was excellent, but his flat, hurried ______ made it hard for the audience to stay interested.
quiz.explain_zh: delivery＝演說方式。內容很好，但平淡急促的表達方式讓聽眾難以專心。

quiz.stem: Students may borrow the lab's cameras over the weekend, ______ they sign a form and promise to return the equipment by Monday morning.
quiz.explain_zh: provided＝只要。只要簽表單並承諾週一早上歸還，就能借相機。

quiz.stem: After twenty years as a doctor in the city, Dr. Chen decided to ______ a charity that offers free eye care to children in remote villages.
quiz.explain_zh: found＝創立（原形動詞）。陳醫師決定創立慈善機構，為偏鄉孩童提供免費眼科照護。

quiz.stem: Studies have linked a lack of sleep to a ______ of health problems, including weight gain, poor memory, and heart disease.
quiz.explain_zh: host＝大量、許多。睡眠不足與許多健康問題有關。

quiz.stem: When Principal Wang retires next summer, Ms. Lin, who has taught here for twenty years, will ______ him as head of the school.
quiz.explain_zh: succeed＝繼任、接替。王校長退休後，將由林老師接替他擔任校長。

quiz.stem: Because Dr. Lee has studied sea turtles for thirty years, her opinions carry a lot of ______ with the officials who make conservation policies.
quiz.explain_zh: weight＝分量、重要性。李博士研究海龜三十年，意見對官員很有分量。

quiz.stem: The baker rolls out the dough to a ______ thickness so that all the cookies on the tray bake at the same speed.
quiz.explain_zh: uniform＝一致的。麵團擀成一致的厚度，餅乾才會同時烤熟。

quiz.stem: The reporter lost her job after her editor discovered that she had ______ quotes from experts who did not even exist.
quiz.explain_zh: manufacture＝捏造。記者捏造根本不存在的專家說的話，因而被解僱。

quiz.stem: The two college friends had a brilliant idea for a language-learning app, but without enough ______ to hire engineers, they had to borrow money from their families.
quiz.explain_zh: capital＝資金。兩人沒有足夠資金聘請工程師，只好向家人借錢。
